items.title: 8.1.4 Key Components of Digital Literacy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the components of digital literacy (PDF 196-197).

items: Technology istemal: computer, tablet aur phone chalana; student word processor se report type aur format karta hai.
Maloomat ki talash: munasib keywords likhna aur nataij behtar karna; Punjab ka kisan 'modern irrigation techniques for wheat' talash karta hai.
Maakhaz ki parakh: dekhna ke mawad kis ne banaya aur maakhaz qabil-e-bharosa hai; Lahore ki ustani dekhti hai ke website taleemi idara chalata hai.
Digital mawad banana: articles, presentations ya edited tasveerein; Karachi ka student PowerPoint presentation banata hai.
Online hifazat aur privacy: mazboot passwords, privacy settings aur mashkook links se bachao; Islamabad ka shakhs mehdood karta hai ke social media par us ki tafseel kaun dekhe.

blocks.prompt: Digital literacy ka aham juz kaunsa hai (MCQ 1)? Maakhaz parakhne ke liye kaunsi maharat zaroori hai (MCQ 3)?
blocks.explanation: (c) digital auzaar ka mo-assar istemal; (c) jaanchna ke mawad bharosemand idare ka hai.

blocks.prompt: Digital literacy aur us ke aham ajza, aur yeh digital auzaar ke mo-assar istemal mein kaise madad deti hai, samjhaiye (long question 2).
blocks.explanation: Digital literacy digital auzaar se maloomat dhoondne, parakhne, banane aur share karne ki maharaton ka majmooa hai. Is ke ajza technology istemal, maloomat ki talash, maakhaz ki parakh, digital mawad banana aur online mehfooz aur private rehna hain. Mil kar yeh insaan ko jaldi durust maloomat tak pohanchne, ghalat ya nuqsan deh mawad se bachne, reports aur presentations jaisa achha kaam banane, aur apne accounts aur data bachane deti hain, jis se parhai, kaam aur rozmarra kaam zyada mo-assar hote hain.

items: Ajza: technology istemal, talash, parakh, banana, hifazat aur privacy.
